name: edu-center-erp
description: Enterprise Educational Center Management System (NestJS + PostgreSQL + React + Tailwind)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && npm run pack:desktop
scripts.dist:win:portable: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && npm run --workspace=@edu-center/desktop pack:portable
scripts.release:win: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && npm run --workspace=@edu-center/desktop stage && npx --workspace=@edu-center/desktop electron-builder --win --x64 --publish always
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web && npm run test:desktop
